select o.id, o.number, o.title, o.description, o.type_id as typeId, t.name as typeName, o.pickup_address as pickupAddress, o.delivery_address as deliveryAddress, o.campus, o.reward_amount as rewardAmount, o.runner_income as runnerIncome, o.expected_time as expectedTime, u.name as publisherName, o.create_time as createTime from orders o left join errand_type t on o.type_id = t.id left join user u on o.user_id = u.id
o.status = 2 and o.pay_status = 1 and o.type_id = #{typeId} and o.campus like concat('%', #{campus}, '%')
and (o.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by o.reward_amount desc, o.create_time desc
